item.title: Mifepristone Access
item.description:
• Summary: The U.S. Supreme Court temporarily extended access to the abortion pill mifepristone, maintaining the status quo while litigation continues. The decision preserves current FDA regulations that allow the drug to be prescribed via telemedicine and mailed, blocking lower court restrictions. The case challenges the FDA’s approval and regulatory actions regarding mifepristone, with potential implications for drug approval authority broadly.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: Dolutegravir Patent Case
item.description:
• Summary: A Colombian court is hearing a patent case regarding dolutegravir, a key HIV drug. The case challenges the patent held by ViiV Healthcare (a GSK/Pfizer joint venture) and could impact access to affordable generic versions of the drug. The outcome may influence patent enforcement and public health policies in low- and middle-income countries, as dolutegravir is a cornerstone of modern HIV treatment regimens.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: Kratom Derivative 7-OH
item.description:
• Summary: The Trump administration has signaled a potential regulatory pivot on the kratom derivative 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH), floating the possibility of approving some forms while restricting others. 7-OH is a potent alkaloid from kratom with opioid-like effects. The move comes amid growing concerns over its abuse potential but also interest in its therapeutic applications for pain and opioid withdrawal. The FDA’s stance remains uncertain, and any regulatory change could impact the burgeoning kratom market.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: FDA Vape Policy
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA has issued new guidance on vaping products that appears to favor the industry by providing clearer pathways for premarket authorization. The guidance outlines updated expectations for applications, including data on product ingredients, toxicology, and abuse potential. Industry groups have welcomed the move as providing regulatory clarity, while public health advocates warn it could lead to more flavored e-cigarettes remaining on the market. The policy shift may accelerate decisions on pending applications.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News
